The '''2011–12 California Golden Bears men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was head coach [[Mike Montgomery (basketball)|Mike Montgomery]]'s fourth season at California. The Golden Bears played their home games at [[Haas Pavilion]] and were members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished with a record of 24–10 overall, 13–5 in Pac-12 play. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2012 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament]] to [[2011–12 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]]. They earned a 12th seed at the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] which they lost in the First Four to [[2011–12 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]].
